The '''Hikil system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Grohl sector/Legends|Grohl sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] and contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hikil]]. Its grid coordinates were R-16.
